title: Network approach of mood and functional gastrointestinal symptom dynamics in relation to childhood trauma in patients with irritable bowel syndrome and comorbid panic disorder
limitations: - Small sample size; - Lack of diversity in sample; - Only low-trauma and non-trauma groups studied, not higher trauma levels; - Low statistical power; - Convergence issues in regression models; - Multiple testing without Bonferroni correction.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data availability are not explicitly stated in the main text or supplementary materials. The authors mention that data were collected as part of a clinical trial (NCT01551225), but do not confirm if the data or code are publicly available.
